title: a-client-reaches-and-a-runner-beats
what: A client that asks the bus one question reaches the device it addresses and pays nothing else; only a process that RUNS the system pays a heartbeat — so the chart, the librarian, the intention extractor and CodeMother's watch stop running a full ground-loop beat on every embed.
why: Akien, 2026-09-09: 'are there any easy efficiency levers we should stop missing before we go on?' — measured: every counsel and learn call paid a 23.5s heartbeat it never used; a voyage pays ~15 such calls (~6 minutes of dead beat), and the context window this was found in had paid 34 (~13 minutes). The lived symptom is CC sitting silent for a quarter of a minute per question while Akien is working with most of his attention elsewhere.
how: Replace connect_bus(devices=['inference_domain']) with reach('inference_domain') at the five client sites (skills/chart/live.py:48, cairn/devices/librarian/live.py:82, cairn/devices/intention_extractor/live.py:35, cairn/devices/codemother/watch.py:40, cairn/devices/codemother/seed_trees.py:34). Add a tooth beside bus_client (cairn/tools/base/proofs) that walks class-space for connect_bus/connect_system callers and refuses any outside the runner roster (web_server/listener.py, ground_loop/__main__.py, bus_client itself) — so the sixth client cannot come back. Correct connect_bus's docstring, which still says beat=True is 'almost always' right.
traces_to: Law 1 — a beat re-derives 78 probes' surveys to answer a question nobody asked; ruling 2026-09-07 under ticket 9579a6f9cec6 (the reach() docstring: 'the difference between RUNNING the system and USING it'); Telos: the resolver spent on the novel.
falsifier: DONE when (1) `python3 -m skills.chart.live counsel <text>` completes in under 1s on a warm host (measured 2026-09-09: 23.5s via connect_bus, 0.18s via reach for the same embed), (2) the tooth reds on a deliberately reintroduced client caller, and (3) the walk finds zero client callers. WRONG INTENT if some client genuinely needs the roster a beat produces — then reach is the wrong shape for it and the beat should be cheap instead, which is ticket 2f0a6ea8c966's line, not this one's.
children: none, because the five edits, one tooth and one probe are one seam at one address; the relocation of bus_client out of tools/base is a SIBLING cast in the same act (see bullets), which this ticket does not depend on and which must carry this probe along when it moves.
